# Turbo Start Paystack

> Open-source multi-tenant SaaS starter that bills through Paystack: a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with Next.js 16, Better Auth organizations and roles, Drizzle on Postgres, and webhook-driven Paystack subscriptions. It runs locally with no Paystack keys against a bundled Paystack mock.

Coding agents should read AGENTS.md first: it has the mental model, the exact first-run commands, the hard billing rules and the done checklist. The recipes below cover one job each. Source: https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack. Live demo (Paystack test mode): https://turbo-start-paystack.vercel.app

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents, covering setup with the mock or test keys, where things live, hard rules, verification and Paystack quirks
- [README.md](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/README.md): setup, the Simulate billing panel, billing flows, roles, deploying and tests

## Recipes

- [Recipe index](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/README.md): every task recipe
- [Add or change a plan](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/add-plan.md): the catalog, `pnpm billing:sync` and currency minimums
- [Add an org-scoped page or route](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/add-org-page.md): `requirePermission` and the organization id from the URL
- [Handle a new webhook event](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/add-webhook-handler.md): idempotent handlers, fixtures and the fake Paystack
- [Add a transactional email](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/add-email.md): React Email templates in packages/email
- [Add a role or permission](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/add-role-or-permission.md): Better Auth access control
- [Deploy to Vercel and Neon](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/deploy-vercel.md): vercel-build, crons and the reconcile workflow
- [Go live](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/go-live.md): test keys to live keys, with a checklist
- [Debug a failed webhook](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/agents/debug-webhook.md): webhook_event, reconcile and the logged error causes

## Docs

- [Decisions](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): why the billing, auth and invoicing work the way they do
- [Paystack setup](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/paystack-setup.md): keys, webhook URL, plans, the reconcile cron and going live
- [Paystack test-mode checklist](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/docs/paystack-verification.md): behaviour to confirm against a real test account
- [Contributing](https://github.com/akintola4/turbo-start-paystack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): checks to run before a pull request
